scope: production dependencies; read-only audit, no package upgrades

packages.assessment: Native bindings are disabled in pnpm-workspace.yaml; self-contained runtime contains no bigint native addon. Existing deployed-bundle test logs pure-JS fallback. The overflow advisory concerns native conversion; retain build constraint.

advisories.title: bigint-buffer Vulnerable to Buffer Overflow via toBigIntLE() Function

packages.assessment: Jayson client uses v4; advisory affects v3/v5/v6 caller-provided output buffers. Our IDs use node crypto and no affected UUID calls.

advisories.title: uuid: Missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when buf is provided

packages.assessment: Not present in the self-contained production server bundle; no application import or streaming JSON server path. Fastify handles bounded HTTP bodies.

advisories.title: stream-json: pick/ignore/filter/replace filters are O(depth²) on nested input — small crafted JSON blocks the event loop for seconds→minutes (DoS)
stream-json: JSONC parser and verifier re-scan the whole accumulated comment on every input chunk
stream-json has a prototype pollution issue: Assembler writes this.current[this.key] on plain objects

packages.assessment: Bundled only through Anchor workspace loader. Application has no workspace accesses, TOML input route or parser call; SDK Program construction uses supplied IDL. Keep dependency warnings tracked rather than claiming removal.

advisories.title: toml-node: Prototype Pollution Leads to `Object.prototype` Corruption via `__proto__` Key-Path Desynchronization
toml-node: Quadratic-complexity DoS via many array-of-tables headers in toml.parse()
toml-node: Quadratic-complexity DoS via long dotted keys or table paths in toml.parse()
toml-node: Uncontrolled resource consumption (CPU DoS) via unbounded-length integer literals in toml.parse()

assessment: Raw dependency audit is not clean. Runtime reachability review found no demonstrated exposed vulnerable function, but this is not an independent penetration test or unconditional security clearance. Reassess before activation and after dependency/build changes.
